title: GOV-0047: freeze badf-solution-design composition contract (DESIGNED, thin router, no second gate)
problem:
## Observed

BADF has no **`badf-solution-design`** capability. The lifecycle already defines the specialist *design* surfaces — G03 (UX and service design: journeys, service-blueprint, accessibility, user-validation) and G04 (architecture, adr, data-model, api-contract, operability-design) — but nothing **composes** the detailed specialist contracts into one coherent solution. A collection of individually-reasonable designs can still be collectively broken: UX says "manager approves refund", authorization has no `refund:approve` action, the API exposes `POST /refunds/{id}/approve`, the data model has no approval state, audit records nothing, and accessibility conveys the failure by color alone. Every artifact looks fine; the **solution is inconsistent**.

## Expected

Freeze **`badf-solution-design`** as a **thin composition/orchestration layer** — a router + constraint contract over the specialist designers, **not** a sixth architecture skill, not a new gate, not a document-generation mega-skill. `badf-architecture` remains the structural spine and G04 coherence authority; `badf-solution-design` composes/routes/reconciles the detailed behavioral contracts and emits G03/G04 evidence.

**WP-SOL-A — contract freeze, `DESIGNED` only.** Deliver `skills/badf-solution-design/SKILL.md` (thin router: what must be designed, which specialist owns it, authoritative inputs, output contract, reconciliation, uncertainty, which gate the evidence goes to) plus references: `composition-contract.md`, `routing.md`, `traceability.md`, `ux-contract.md`, `authorization-contract.md`, `data-contract.md`, `api-contract.md`, `accessibility-contract.md`, `cross-artifact-consistency.md`, `acceptance.md`, `external-methodology.md`. Register `DESIGNED`.

Freeze the cross-artifact invariants **SOL-I01…SOL-I12** (requirement provenance; architecture consistency; UX↔API; API↔authorization; default-deny; authorization↔audit; API↔data; UX↔error; accessibility-binds-behavior; migration safety; API compatibility; **SOL-I12 no second gate** — no `scripts/badf_solution_design.py`), the solution-composition matrix concept (a detailed-design RTM: requirement → ux/api/authz/data/audit/a11y/test refs), the `authorization-design` framing (principal·resource·action·scope·context·policy·decision·audit; RBAC as one model), the API DESIGN/ASSURE split (mirroring `badf-architecture`), and the FRAME→INGEST→ROUTE→SPECIALIZE→COMPOSE→RECONCILE→CHALLENGE→TRACE→PACKAGE workflow.

**Boundaries (no scope creep):** no runtime, no second validator, no specialist activation, **no `lifecycle.json` change** (compose into existing G03/G04 evidence). Specialist skills and seam-validation controls in the canonical gate are **separate later WPs** (WP-SOL-B..).

## Evidence

- Current `main` `8673d9a`: `badf-architecture` is **ACTIVE** (the structural spine / G04 authority), `badf-research` ACTIVE, `badf-git` DESIGNED. G03/G04 evidence contracts are enforced. No `skills/badf-solution-design/` exists.
- Same controlled admission pattern used by `badf-research` and `badf-architecture` and `badf-git`: contract freeze first (`DESIGNED`), then implementation/validation/shadow in separate WPs.

## Unknowns

Whether the composition matrix earns a dedicated ID family (`SDM-NNNN`) or a plain `solution-composition` artifact — deferred to WP-SOL-B (no global ID family invented without proven need). Whether any G03/G04 seam becomes a deterministic gate control — a later failing-first WP, never a fabricated control here.
